newsitem.title: USA: Pediatrix Medical buys neonatology practice.
newsitem.headline: Pediatrix Medical buys neonatology practice.

text.p: Pediatrix Medical Group Inc said Wednesday it had acquired Pediatric Consultants for $2 million cash, a move it said would provide an immediate increase in per-share earnings.
The company said the expected positive financial effect includes a contribution to this year's third quarter earnings.
The purchase will be funded from Pediatrix Medical's cash reserves, which currently exceed $70 million, the company said.
Pediatric Consultants is a neonatology group practice based in Reno, Nev. Pediatrix Medical provides physician management services.
